answer: Each identity escrows a bond against a commitment salted with the epoch words, so this round basalt, lotus and juniper must appear in the signed preimage before any peer countersigns the receipt. Two unrelated jurors then re-execute the job from identical inputs and compare output hashes; one mismatch freezes payment and opens a slashing vote that burns half the bond. A farm of 500 fakes needs 500 funded bonds plus 500 reproducible runs, and it loses the lot on the first failed audit.
